title: How India's ambitions to build and export a sovereign AI template are colliding with structural constraints, including a dependence on foreign AI infrastructure (Saritha Rai/Bloomberg)
summary: Saritha Rai / Bloomberg: How India's ambitions to build and export a sovereign AI template are colliding with structural constraints, including a dependence on foreign AI infrastructure — India hopes to build an AI model for the Global South, but a late start and dependence on foreign AI infrastructure are testing that vision.
